name: tuition-management-app
description: Tuition Management App – MERN (MongoDB, Express, React, Node)

scripts.install-all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client --include=dev && npm run build --prefix client
